description.p: RT85 Manager configures the Epomaker RT85 mechanical keyboard on Linux, with a native COSMIC interface.

ul.li: Built-in lighting effects: mode, speed, brightness, direction and colour
Per-key RGB colours on a clickable keyboard layout
Upload images and animated GIFs to the built-in screen
Clock sync and live CPU usage and temperature on the screen

description.p: The keyboard protocol is reverse-engineered and support is experimental.

screenshot.caption: Per-key colours on the RT85 layout
Settings: layout, colour scheme and frosted glass

description.p: No more manual udev step: the app sets up keyboard access itself.

ul.li: Installs the udev rule through polkit the first time it sees a keyboard, with one password prompt
Only asks again if the installed rule is missing or out of date
New rt85 setup-udev command, with --print to install the rule by hand
The window no longer freezes on Rescan or device switching while the keyboard is busy

description.p: RT85 support built from Epomaker's own driver: its command set, screen and key map.

ul.li: Asks the keyboard which model it is, since several share one USB ID
RT85 lighting with its 22 effects, remapping and per-key colours on its own commands
Real RT85 key positions from Epomaker's default key map
Full 320x172 screen: still images, full-screen GIFs and a wide now-playing card
Screen language switch; clear screen and CPU/temperature widgets stay RT100-only

description.p: Macros, live screen content, RT85 75% layout and desktop integration.

ul.li: Macros: key, text and delay steps on any key, played by the app while it runs
Live screen: now-playing media with cover art and time bar, game FPS from MangoHud
RT85 75% board in US ANSI or UK ISO, with square keycaps
Settings: follow the COSMIC theme or KDE colour scheme, frosted glass
Window controls now show on KDE and GNOME

description.p: First release: lighting, per-key colours, remapping, screen upload and widgets.
